decisions.reason: As a close-to-core express offer in a growing market, the firm can readily justify another year of continuation by pointing to prior rollout investment and treating any remaining issues as operational fine-tuning.

The seventy-two-hour promise remains the most demanding operationally, but sunk commitment, service-positioning, and the tendency to attribute shortfalls to capacity adjustment still make continuation more likely than withdrawal.

This certified fire-resistant exterior door is highly visible, tightly linked to the firm's safety-focused core, and backed by prior development and public launch commitment, so management is very unlikely to abandon it.
A dedicated express line with several models reflects substantial resource commitment and visible market positioning, which under escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it on offer.

The online ordering and digital services platform is strategically central to the firm's move toward deeper service and advisory support, and its sunk investment and integration effects make withdrawal especially unlikely.
